class.name: Axis
class.brief_description: An infinite 3D axis defined by an origin and a direction.
class.description: [Axis] wraps OpenCASCADE's [code]gp_Ax1[/code]. Use the static factory methods to create an axis from an origin and direction vector, a [Location], or a linear [Edge]. The [member direction] value is always normalized by OpenCASCADE.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates an axis from [param origin] and [param direction]. The direction must be non-zero.

method.name: from_edge
method.description: Creates an axis from the start point and tangent of [param edge]. The edge must have a valid 3D curve.

method.name: from_location
method.description: Creates an axis by transforming the global positive Z axis by [param location].

method.name: copy
method.description: Returns a new [Axis] with the same [member position] and [member direction].

method.name: deepcopy
method.description: Returns a new [Axis] with the same [member position] and [member direction]. The [param memo] argument is accepted for API compatibility.

method.name: neg
method.description: Returns a new [Axis] with the same [member position] and the opposite [member direction].

members.member: The axis origin in world coordinates.
